scope: Isolated low-resolution experimental comparison; no single-grid convergence claim
additional_sigma: Only one nearby value, and only after a documented short-test mechanism motivates it; no unrestricted scan
boundary: Exact beta=-alpha sqrt(chi/g); incoming gauge projection changes Lambda and independent endpoint chi_r,g_r,beta_r together; b_t=sigma(beta-b). All outgoing/tangent characteristic jet amplitudes and Lambda-V boundary constraint trace preserved by the projection. Derivative reduction defects remain explicit diagnostics.

long_comparison_predeclared.duration: All guards hold through target with fixed parameters and timestep
long_comparison_predeclared.constraints: At matched N257 times, time-RMS H/M/Theta/Z exterior norms no greater than twice the advective reference over the common completed interval; report each metric separately
long_comparison_predeclared.reduced_horizon_coordinate_drift: Absolute least-squares drift slope on last20M at most half the matched advective slope; also report total drift and fit residual
long_comparison_predeclared.settling: Report field-rate RMS and gauge residuals versus time; horizon flattening alone is insufficient
long_comparison_predeclared.validity: Finite positive physical geometry at every evaluated positive-radius stage, positive new speed margin, relative nullness<=5e-14, scri numerator<=.01, driver compatibility<=1e-10, speed CFL<=.4
long_comparison_predeclared.interior: Retain and plot separately; no interior truncation threshold in exterior budget
long_comparison_predeclared.boundary_reduction: Report independent endpoint derivative minus finite-difference derivative, including any growth; no well-posedness inference from roundoff nullness

execution.continuation: Only source/library/checkpoint/ancestry-verified completed parents; no retry or relabeling of failed/bounded runs
